name: Super Battle Golf: Attack on City
summary:
New Features in Attack on City:
- New City Biome with 9 new holes and traffic hazards
- 7 Forest maps
- 2 Desert Maps
- Team Mode
- 5 New Items
- More cosmetics: Shoes and ball in hole effects added!
- 6 New Achievements
